
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20111832" title="发布于 2026-05-21 19:46">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript异步执行与await关键字</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="B2NXDvis">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，从1.2.5版本开始支持异步解析执行以及新增&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">@@CancellationToken</span>&nbsp;关键字。</p>
<h2>一、异步解析执行</h2>
<p data-pid="Z8EkTQIj">AScript提供了&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Script.EvalAsync</span>&nbsp;异步方法，异步执行脚本，可设置&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">CancellationToken</span>&nbsp;参数。</p>
<p data-pid="qYd-AxfP">AScript执行模式有解析执行和编译执行两种模式，这两种模式下的异步执行又有所不同：</p>
<p data-pid="3Wb4QyOW">1）解析执行模式：异步解析，异步执行，并且异步执行脚本中&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;后面的方法；</p>
<p data-pid="nGT_qOFX">2）编译执行模式：异步解析，同步编译，同步执行，脚本中&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;后面的方法则会调用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task.Wait()</span>&nbsp;或者&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task&lt;T&gt;.Result</span>&nbsp;来等待完成。</p>
<p data-pid="O-QzRa1f">示例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 100毫秒超时</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cts = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CancellationTokenSource(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 异步读取脚本文件，异步解析脚本，异步执行脚本，如果超时100毫秒则报OperationCanceledException异常</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> script.EvalAsync(File.OpenRead(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mycode.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), cancellationToken: cts.Token);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">value:{result.Value}, type:{result.Type}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h2>二、await关键字</h2>
<p data-pid="-burN4co">脚本中调用异步方法并等待完成，使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;关键字，当然也可以直接调用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task.Wait()</span>&nbsp;或者&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task&lt;T&gt;.Result</span>&nbsp;来等待完成，为什么推荐使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;呢？</p>
<p data-pid="46GjCejD">1）异步执行时，脚本中的方法也是异步的；</p>
<p data-pid="RNCMk5nB">2）同步执行时，等效于&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task.Wait()</span>&nbsp;或者&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Task&lt;T&gt;.Result</span>&nbsp;；</p>
<p data-pid="KrZ3CkGu">3）如果&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;后面的方法不是异步方法，则自动忽略&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;；</p>
<p data-pid="Iccrau_7">所以脚本中使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;关键字更省心更安全。</p>
<p data-pid="GhT_oRiE">示例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt; sum = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> (a, b) =&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Task.Delay(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = await sum(5, 10);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">await Task.Delay(500);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a + 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sum);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 异步执行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.EvalAsync(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">35</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.Value);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), result.Type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 同步执行，等效于：var a = sum(5, 10).Result; Task.Delay(500).Wait(); a + 20</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">35</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="rcTDV2On">&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;关键字实现原理请查看源码&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AScript.TokenHandlers.AwaitTokenHandler</span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AScript.Functions.AwaitFunction</span>&nbsp;。</p>
<h2>三、@@CancellationToken关键字</h2>
<p data-pid="f2XKNUTK">1）异步执行时，值为&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">EvalAsync</span>&nbsp;方法参数中的&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">CancellationToken</span>&nbsp;；</p>
<p data-pid="GV2EkiFO">2）同步执行时，值为&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">CancellationToken.None</span>&nbsp;。</p>
<p data-pid="aHpYkBUH">示例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 100毫秒超时</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cts = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CancellationTokenSource(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Assert.ThrowsExceptionAsync&lt;TaskCanceledException&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> () =&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> script.EvalAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">await Task.Delay(1000, @@CancellationToken)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, cancellationToken: cts.Token);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> });</pre>
</div>
<p>实现原理：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationTokenHandler : ITokenHandler, IAsyncTokenHandler
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> CancellationTokenHandler Instance = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationTokenHandler();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TreeBuilder.AddData(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, CancellationToken.None);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task BuildAsync(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TreeBuilder.AddData(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, cancellationToken);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="2HKZC1bM">在&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">CSharpLang</span>&nbsp;中注册：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@@CancellationToken</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, CancellationTokenHandler.Instance);</span>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>四、总结</h2>
<p data-pid="NpKRjZ9o">AScript提供了&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">EvalAsync</span>&nbsp;方法来异步读取、解析、执行脚本；</p>
<p data-pid="ODzr1zUB">脚本中使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span></span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">@@CancellationToken</span>&nbsp;关键字来异步调用方法及传递取消令牌并等待结果。</p>
<p data-pid="gM3BXzka">开源地址：<a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a><a class=" wrap external" href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043"><br></a></p>

</div>
